skill.summary: Persistent memory system for AI agents — remember facts, learn from experience, and track entities across sessions.

latestVersion.changelog:
Agent-memory-hardened 1.0.0

- Initial release of a persistent memory system for AI agents.
- Supports storing/retrieving facts, learning from experience, and tracking entities across sessions.
- Includes clear usage examples for fact recall, lesson learning, and entity tracking.
- Outlines best practices for integrating session memory into agent workflows.
- Built-in security guardrails prevent covert surveillance, external data leaks, and storage of sensitive personal information.
